[RBND.4b.6] **Producer responsibility.** The compiler computes
`rt_config_sha256` from the author's `.dsrt` per [RTCT.4.4]
and embeds it in both the `RealtimeContract` atom body and the
`DscHeader.rt_config_sha256` field. The runtime never
recomputes the hash from contract values at load time — it
loads the hash directly from the atom. Per-load
consistency-check obligations are in [RTCT.6.5].
